# Search for Nintendo Switch Lite products on Amazon
import re

amazon_pwd = [c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
access_token = apis.amazon.login(username='kevin.blac@gmail.com', password=amazon_pwd)['access_token']

api = apis.amazon.search_products

query = 'Nintendo Switch Lite'
all_results = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20

while True:
    page = api(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # page is expected list
    if not page:
        break
    all_results.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break

print('Total results fetched:', len(all_results))
# Print first 10 raw matches overview
preview = [(r.get('product_id'), r.get('name'), r.get('color'), r.get('relative_size'), r.get('price'), r.get('delivery_days'), r.get('product_type')) for r in all_results[:10]]
print('Preview (up to 10):', preview)

# Post-filter exact product name containing Switch Lite (case-insensitive)
filtered = [r for r in all_results if re.search(r'\bSwitch\s+Lite\b', (r.get('name') or ''), flags=re.I)]
print('Filtered to name contains "Switch Lite":', len(filtered))
print('Filtered IDs/names/colors:', [(r['product_id'], r['name'], r.get('color'), r.get('price'), r.get('delivery_days')) for r in filtered])
